memory_candidates: A binder-free twin of a Lean declaration stated over a Category instance cannot use the category notation (an arrow, a functor arrow, composition, the identity, or a predicate taking [Category E]): the twin supplies no instance. The working shape is an @-applied type naming both instances explicitly, a letI installing the twin instance inside the body where a structure instance is built, @-applied field projections in downstream statements, and @[reducible] on the twin def so that projection-of-constructor reductions downstream proofs relied on still fire at reducible transparency.
